title: Move SOA item search and attachment extraction to GPT-5.5 deployments
summary: Sales Order Agent AI operations move to GPT-5.5 chat deployments for attachment extraction, item search expansion, and item selection while leaving other SOA AI calls on GPT-4.1.
key_points: Attachment extraction, keyword expansion, and item ranking now use GPT-5.5 chat deployments
Message and attachment relevance checks remain on GPT-4.1 latest
Multimodal file support continues for attachment extraction through updated allow-list
No changes to prompts, schemas, temperature, max tokens, or JSON mode settings
quote: Moves three Sales Order Agent AI calls to the GPT-5.5 chat deployments
